candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Payment logs show repeated 503s including /readyz, indicating payment is unavailable/unhealthy rather than slow.
candidates.uncertainty: Cause of payment 503 (config, dependency, crash) not established; payment traces/metrics excluded by budget.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 originates from order calling payment, which returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed (200). Payment logs confirm repeated 503s including readiness. Gateway metrics show checkout 502s. Root cause is bounded to payment unavailability, but the underlying reason for payment 503 is not yet evidenced.
